properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated September 18, [1933] on stationery from the Metropole Hotel in Shanghai; includes description of approaching typhoon and plans to move Sikorsky aircraft to Nanking [Nanjing] foiled by the storm, procedures to protect the aircraft during the storm.
